_note: Worlds already shipped with this skill. A new project must differ from each on at least 4 axes, one of them palette or type, and must not reuse a family or action colour listed here. Add yours when you finish.

worlds.product: Funding search for founders: reads programs' official pages, keeps each fact only with its word-for-word quote and date, checks eligibility against the founder
